facts.claim: Sana Qureshi of Brightloop offered Arjun two times for a call: Tuesday the fourth of August at three in the afternoon, or Wednesday the fifth at eleven in the morning, India time.
Sana said she would send an invite once Arjun confirms one of them.
Her mail answers a thread titled Nimbus Labs x Brightloop, whose earlier mail is not in the file, and opens with happy to chat.
Her mail is the file's only touch, over three days ago; the dossier says we have not written in the file and marks the move as ours.

inferences.claim: The move is Arjun's: no invite comes until he picks a time.
The first slot is Tuesday afternoon, so a confirmation is needed by Monday for Sana to send the invite in time; after Tuesday only Wednesday's slot is left, and after Wednesday morning neither.
Sana proposed the times herself, so Brightloop is willing to talk; leaving her offer unanswered past the first slot spends that goodwill.

hypotheses.needs: Arjun's word, or Sana's invite arriving.

frames.primary: A call offered and waiting on us: Sana proposed Tuesday afternoon or Wednesday morning and will send the invite once Arjun picks one; nothing is set yet, and the first slot is close.
rivals: The time was settled outside this mailbox and the file only looks open.
Brightloop's interest is light, and an offer left unanswered will be read as Arjun's lack of interest.

proposed_kind.why: The thread pairs Nimbus Labs and Brightloop as two companies looking to talk, the shape partner talks take, and the brief sets landing design partners as a goal while naming no kind of work for this file. Proposed for the founder to confirm.

expected_vs_actual.expected: Without a playbook, from the file: an offer of two times expects an answer before the first of them, so the invite can go out.
expected_vs_actual.actual: Over three days on, the file holds only Sana's offer: no answer from Arjun and no invite.

scenarios.do_nothing: Tuesday's slot passes, then Wednesday's; no invite comes, and the call has to be asked for again, by us, with the goodwill spent.
scenarios.act: One line taking a slot today lets Sana send the invite, and the call happens this week.
scenarios.best: Arjun takes Tuesday, the invite arrives, and the call opens real partner talks with Brightloop.
scenarios.worst: Both slots pass unanswered, Sana reads it as no interest, and Brightloop goes quiet.
signals_to_watch: Sana's invite arriving after Arjun answers
Sana proposing new times or asking again
Tuesday afternoon arriving with no time agreed

reasons: The first slot is Tuesday afternoon, with only Monday between now and then.
Sana waits on Arjun's answer before she sends the invite.

next_move.what: Take one of Sana's two times, Tuesday the fourth at three in the afternoon or Wednesday the fifth at eleven in the morning, India time, and tell her so she can send the invite
